Class PlayerHealth

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.PlayerHealth
public final class PlayerHealth extends Object
How the server's players are doing (API version 39): who is new, who comes back, how long they play, when the server is busy, and how long new players' first visit lasts. Core samples everyone online with Activity; time away from the keyboard never counts as played. Kept in universe/mods/atomictempest/player-health/, on this server only. 
PlayerHealth.activeMinutes(uuid);   // minutes really played, ever
PlayerHealth.firstDay(uuid);        // the day they first joined (LocalDate.toEpochDay), or -1
